Pricing Table Generator

Design a 2–4 tier pricing table — live preview plus production-ready HTML and CSS.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose the number of tiers (2–4) and fill in each plan.
  2. Add one feature per line and mark the popular plan.
  3. Preview the table live, tweak colors and theme.
  4. Copy the code or download the self-contained pricing.html.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I mark the popular plan?

Use the "Highlight tier" dropdown — that plan gets a scaled-up card, a badge, and the accent border.

Can I use a different currency?

Yes — just type any currency symbol or code into the price fields.

Is the table responsive?

Yes. The grid collapses to a single column on narrow screens.

Can I embed it in my site?

Copy the markup and the embedded <style> block. All classes are prefixed with pt- to avoid conflicts.
